name: Satarre
heading: Unbound Satarre
sourceDistinctions: Book of Ebon Tides prints Unbound Satarre as a subrace. This profile uses the printed Unbound rules under the existing Satarre catalog name. The base profile is cross-referenced to Tome of Heroes.

name: Lamia
heading: Lamia
sourceDistinctions: The book’s player option has a human upper body and serpentine lower body. Its Medium Monstrosity profile stays separate from the leonine monster record.
The last four traits are at the top of p. 16, before the Ramag entry.

name: Mushroomfolk
heading: Mushroomfolk
sourceDistinctions: The book presents Acid Cap, Favored, and Morel as Mushroomfolk subraces. The example uses Morel. Mushroomfolk has its own player profile and creature type.
